networks.name: pasar
networks.description: Plan a purchase across several small shops: the concierge asks each shop's own assistant, compares their answers and puts a plan with order links on the page.
sample_queries: Lunch and snacks for 30 people the day after tomorrow at 12:00, budget Rp2.000.000.
Vegetarian rice boxes for 15 people on Saturday at 11:00, delivered.
Which shops deliver to Setiabudi, and what do they sell?
Book me a hotel in Bali.

peer_policy.note: Pasar calls the shop sites in allowed_peers, each after the visitor agrees on a card. Only the request text is sent; the visitor's district only when they allow it.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
